title: Moment of Inertia of a Cylinder in Cylindrical Coordinates
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Find I_z for a cylinder of radius R = 2, height h = 5, and density delta = 1.

steps.title: Set Up Triple Integral for I_z
steps.mathExpression: I_z = \int_0^{2\pi} d\theta \int_0^5 dz \int_0^2 r^2 (r \, dr) = (2\pi)(5) \int_0^2 r^3 \, dr
steps.explanation: The integrand is squared distance from z-axis: x^2 + y^2 = r^2.
steps.why: Formulating moment of inertia in cylindrical coordinates.
